differences_from_pinned_action: Pinned action uses all-features Cargo metadata only to derive an external package/name allowlist; Cargo clean uses workspace package ownership. Neither populates absent feature variants.
Pinned action removes root .rustc_info.json and non-build/.fingerprint/deps profile entries; Cargo clean model leaves .rustc_info.json and three zero-byte Cargo lock files.
Pinned action also prunes and archives registry/git and may cargo/bin. This trial uses one unchanged registry-warm root and compares target snapshots only.
Pinned action restore exact/prefix behavior, timestamp fallback cleanup, immutability and one successful trusted-writer publication are not executed locally.
APFS clone restore is local and mtime-preserving; GitHub archive extraction/compression/network and Linux native dependencies are unmeasured.

ordering_and_limitations: Local macOS ARM != hosted Linux; registry warm, target cold.
Compile-only --no-run is not test execution or CI acceptance.
Every reader arm uses the exact same absolute active target path.
Cargo workspace clean models source-output pruning; it is not the pinned action filesystem cleanup algorithm.
APFS private clones model local copy overhead, not Actions compression/network/archive transfer.
HOME and provider credentials are absent from the explicit allowlist; shared Cargo registry is read for locked offline dependencies.
Role warm precedes shared warm, so page-cache/order effects remain; all comparisons disclosed, not a hosted speedup claim.

narrow_adaptation.status: read-only narrow adaptation assessment; no implementation

proposed_group.reader_execution: browser-binary always uses Rust cache; proof/shards keep existing condition steps.binary.outputs.mode == source. Current artifact consumers never restore compiler cache.
proposed_group.prefix_key: Preserve existing prepared cold_caches ternary exactly, including run/attempt nonce on controlled cold runs; otherwise nac-ci-v1.
proposed_group.manual_key: shared-key replaces both key and automatic GITHUB_JOB suffix; key does not provide a role suffix alongside shared-key. Remove the redundant key field only in participating jobs if implemented.
preserved: add-job-id-key default; superseded by shared-key for group only
pinned Rust runtime and all source/build/feature/test/proof behavior
same original parallel dependency graph; no reader waits for writer cache publication
no cache-hit test/build skipping or verdict reuse
all original permissions and untrusted PR/tag/manual write exclusions

pinned_semantics.key: prefix-key + shared-key (or manual key + job) + OS/architecture + default environment hash + manifest/lock/config hash
pinned_semantics.environment: Restore exports CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 before deriving keys. Sorted installed Rust release/host/commit identities and nonempty env prefixes CARGO,CC,CFLAGS,CXX,CMAKE,RUST are hashed. NAC_* source identity is outside that default prefix set; workspace outputs are pruned and rebuilt.
pinned_semantics.command_flags: CLI features/profile/target are not independently hashed; keep this group limited to measured default server/browser command family and encode family in namespace. Do not normalize unrelated roles or disable default hashes.
pinned_semantics.restore: Exact key first, then environment-prefix key; old-manifest fallback uses pinned timestamp cleanup, not a complete dependency union.
pinned_semantics.save: Only nonexact/miss eligible writer saves. Exact hit is frozen and readers cannot augment it. Missing variants safely rebuild every time until key/namespace/expiry changes.
pinned_semantics.failure: Action post-if permits success or CACHE_ON_FAILURE=true; restore forces CACHE_ON_FAILURE=false unless explicitly opted in. Keep default failure behavior unchanged.

observed_hosted_role_keys.finding: All four observed role hashes already match a7860c54-055f132a. Namespace sharing need not weaken profile/env hashing. These were misses; no trusted seed with that profile currently exists in the cache inventory.

local_target_raw.limits: Uncompressed target-only byte sums, not GitHub compressed archive occupancy, network transfer, total registry/git bundles or actual billed cost.

capacity.compressed_savings: UNKNOWN: no new-profile shared/role archive exists; the local snapshots were target-only APFS copies, not GHA zstd archives. Legacy stored metadata includes registry/git/bin and different profile graphs. Do not claim 50% compressed capacity saving from raw target equality.
capacity.cap_limit_caveat: Usage endpoint does not return the configured storage limit; historical10GiB cap is not revalidated here. No setting changes.
capacity.role_keys: Four logical roles can become one shared namespace, at most3 eliminated role keys per matching env/manifest tuple, not9 matrix caches. In artifact-dominant runs only server+producer cache use is common; proof/shards cache use occurs on source fallback.
capacity.migration: A new namespace begins cold and overlaps old entries until natural eviction; current usage is near the previously observed10GiB cap. Do not delete old caches, raise limits or assume immediate occupied-storage reduction.

hazards: The first trusted push has parallel readers before the writer post-save; retain the normal cold commands rather than adding a seed dependency.

An incomplete exact writer entry is immutable. The local browser had0 extra external recompiles; workspace4 had73 and remains excluded. Namespace-version or graph change is needed if future measured browser coverage proves incomplete.

Runner image rollout can change installed Rust/environment hashes, forcing cold entries. Even unchanged hashes can encounter ordinary Cargo/native fingerprint rebuilds; do not disable identity hashing to force hits.
S09 runtime executable admission and its image/attempt/source fallback stay mandatory and separate from dependency caching.
Linux native graph, actual archive transfer/compression, initial occupancy/eviction and whole-path compute remain unmeasured for this adaptation.
narrow_adaptation.decision: A narrow server/browser Linux validation candidate is justified by actual local coverage and observed compatible hosted hashes. Root agreement is still required before implementation; this task creates no workflow edits, caches, publication or new strategy credit.

raw_evidence.notes: Raw Cargo JSON retains exact package IDs, targets, feature lists, profiles, Fresh flags, output filenames and build-script events. Snapshot manifests retain per-file hashes/bytes/inodes; logs retain native time/RSS. Copies were removed only after receipt and immutability checks. No quality verdict or workspace compiled output is reused.

publication: The local trial made no source/workflow/cache/settings edits. This delivery adds the subsequently authorized narrow workflow candidate, focused parsed controls and portable evidence. No hosted cache was written, no workflow run dispatched, no settings changed and no push/PR made by this worker.
